            histories = _read_split(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, f"{ds}_train.txt"))
            eligible_users = [u for u in sorted(histories) if histories[u]]
            if not eligible_users:
                raise ValueError(f"No training history available for export audit: {ds}")
            user = eligible_users[0]
            history = histories[user][-meta["maxlen"]:]
            sequence = torch.zeros((1, meta["maxlen"]), dtype=torch.long)
            sequence[0, -len(history):] = torch.tensor(history)
            # Include the complete catalog and cross the export chunk boundary.
            candidates = list(range(1, meta["itemnum"] + 1))
            with torch.inference_mode():
                features = reference.final_features(sequence)
                expected_chunks = []
                for start in range(0, len(candidates), 4096):
                    ids = torch.tensor([candidates[start:start + 4096]])
                    expected_chunks.append(reference.predict_score(
                        features, ids, "candidates"
                    )[0])
                expected = torch.cat(expected_chunks)
                actual = torch.tensor(exported.predict(
                    user, history, candidates, dataset_name=ds
                ), dtype=expected.dtype)
            if actual.shape != expected.shape or not bool(torch.isfinite(actual).all()):
                raise RuntimeError(f"Invalid exported scores for {ds}")
            torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-5)
            expected_order = torch.argsort(expected, descending=True, stable=True)[:10]
            actual_order = torch.argsort(actual, descending=True, stable=True)[:10]
            if not torch.equal(expected_order, actual_order):
                raise RuntimeError(f"Exported top-10 ranking disagreement for {ds}")
            audit_records[ds] = {
                "training_user": int(user),
                "candidate_count": len(candidates),
                "maximum_absolute_error": float((actual - expected).abs().max()),
                "top10_ranking_disagreements": 0,
